# TarkovAutoShade

This directory contains source derived from TarkovAutoShade:

- Source: https://github.com/Re5pawnn/TarkovAutoShade
- Upstream commit: `f5020769535e2009d1c3ce30f4a7192dad69d77a`
- Original author credit in the upstream README: `lub大萝卜`

hotkeys and application UI remain provided by TarkovMapLocatorDesktop.
